evidence: We are integrating AI into our data science platform to assist in analyzing and extracting more insights from our internal documents.
We have created internal generative AI chatbots, using our proprietary information to interact with and answer queries by our employees about our human resources and other relevant policies.

Our data science team, led by doctorate-level statisticians and mathematicians is focused on building and refining proprietary statistical models and algorithms to project financial performance, predict lease-up and occupancy trends.
We are integrating generative AI tools into our systems and our third-party business partners, including operators, tenants and vendors, may also develop or use such tools.
AI solutions and features may become more important to our operations or to our future growth.
ai_positioning.summary: WELL intègre l'IA en interne pour optimiser ses décisions d'investissement immobilier et ses opérations via sa plateforme de data science propriétaire et des chatbots IA génératives, tout en reconnaissant les risques réglementaires et de sécurité associés.
